title: athyrium yunnanense
intro: Athyrium yunnanense, commonly known as Yunnan Lady fern, is a species of fern native to China. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Yunnan Lady fern include its ability to calm the nervous system and relieve anxiety, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe muscle spasms and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Yunnan Lady fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
